reassurance_anchor.text_en: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near.

verses.arabic_text: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ
verses.translation_en: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near.

socratic_dropdowns.question: Why is 'say' missing?
socratic_dropdowns.answer: Every other place in the Quran, the command 'say' is used. Here, it is left out. The answer is placed directly after the question.

evidence.why_cited: A nearby verse where 'say' is used.
The 'say' is left out, and the answer comes directly.

verses.arabic_text: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ
verses.translation_en: And We are closer to him than his jugular vein.

socratic_dropdowns.question: What is the jugular vein?
socratic_dropdowns.answer: It is the vein in the neck. It is one of the closest things to a person. The verse places Allah closer than that.

evidence.arabic: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ
evidence.translation_en: And We are closer to him than his jugular vein.
evidence.why_cited: It describes closeness as physical and immediate.

evidence.arabic: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى الْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ الشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌ
evidence.translation_en: When the two receivers receive, seated on the right and on the left.
evidence.why_cited: It shows angels are also near, recording.

verses.translation_en: Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us.

socratic_dropdowns.question: What does 'with us' mean?
socratic_dropdowns.answer: It is stated directly. Presence is promised, not earned.

evidence.translation_en: Indeed, Allah is with the patient.
evidence.why_cited: It names patience as a station of His presence.

evidence.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوا وَّالَّذِينَ هُم مُّحْسِنُونَ
evidence.translation_en: Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good.
evidence.why_cited: It names two more stations of His presence.

verses.translation_en: And He is with you wherever you are.

socratic_dropdowns.question: What does this verse say about presence?
socratic_dropdowns.answer: It is without location. Without condition. Without exception.

evidence.translation_en: And He is with you wherever you are.
And Allah is Seeing of what you do.

verses.arabic_text: لَا تَخَافَا إِنَّنِي مَعَكُمَا أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ
verses.translation_en: Do not fear. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.

socratic_dropdowns.question: Where was this said?
socratic_dropdowns.answer: To Musa and Harun, when they were sent to Pharaoh. They were afraid. Allah spoke to them directly.

evidence.arabic: لَا تَخَافَا إِنَّنِي مَعَكُمَا أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ
evidence.translation_en: Do not fear. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.
evidence.why_cited: It names hearing and seeing as part of His presence.

evidence.translation_en: Indeed, we are messengers of your Lord.
evidence.why_cited: It shows the comfort was given before the mission began.
